skill.name: code-review
skill.description: Perform code reviews following Sentry engineering practices. Use when reviewing pull requests, examining code changes, or providing feedback on code quality. Covers security, performance, testing, and design review.
skill.summary: Guide AI code reviews using Sentry-style checks for correctness, security, performance, tests, and design.
skill.author: getsentry

content.value_statement: Pull request reviews often miss risks across correctness, security, performance, and testing. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured Sentry review checklist.
actual_capabilities: Guides review comments toward actionable risk reduction.
Checks changes for runtime errors, performance issues, and side effects.
Highlights security concerns such as injection, XSS, access control, and secret exposure.
Prompts review of test coverage for business logic and critical paths.
Identifies changes that may need senior engineering review.
limitations: It provides review guidance and does not inspect repositories by itself.
It reflects Sentry engineering practices, which may not match every team.
It cannot prove correctness without project context, tests, and runtime results.
It does not replace human ownership of merge decisions.

use_cases.title: Review a pull request
use_cases.description: Apply a structured checklist before approving changes that affect product behavior.

use_cases.title: Assess risky architecture changes
use_cases.description: Flag database, API, framework, and security-sensitive changes for deeper review.

use_cases.title: Improve review consistency
use_cases.description: Give teams a shared standard for feedback tone, test expectations, and blocking concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Basic PR Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request for correctness, tests, security, and performance. Focus on issues that should block merge.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small pull request

prompt_templates.title: Test Coverage Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changed tests and identify missing coverage for business logic, integrations, and critical user paths.
prompt_templates.scenario: Checking whether tests match the requirements

prompt_templates.title: Risk-Focused Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these changes for runtime errors, side effects, backwards compatibility, ORM performance, and security vulnerabilities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Reviewing a change with broad product impact

prompt_templates.title: Senior Escalation Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request and identify any database, API, framework, performance-critical, or security-sensitive changes needing senior review.

output_examples.input: Review a pull request that adds a billing workflow and database migration.
output: Blocking: the migration may lock a large table during deploy.
Blocking: failed payment retries need integration test coverage.
Question: should support receive an alert when billing fails?

output_examples.input: Review a React change that loads user-specific project data.
output: Blocking: the effect may use stale project identifiers.
Non-blocking: add a loading state test for the project switcher.
Suggestion: keep the comment focused on user-visible risk.
Blocking: confirm the endpoint enforces object-level access control.
Blocking: add a regression test for unauthorized access.
Escalation: request senior review before merging this change.

best_practices: Provide the diff, affected requirements, and test results with the prompt.
Ask for blocking issues first, then non-blocking suggestions.
Use project context to validate whether Sentry-specific guidance applies.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as the only approval signal for risky changes.
Do not request style-only feedback when the goal is risk reduction.
Do not ignore failing tests or missing context in the review.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews pull requests for correctness, security, performance, test coverage, design fit, and long-term risk.

faq.question: Does it run tests?
faq.answer: No. It guides review reasoning and can interpret test results you provide.

faq.question: Is it only for Sentry projects?
faq.answer: No. It is based on Sentry practices, but many checks apply to general software projects.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it approve pull requests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps identify risks, but a responsible reviewer should make the merge decision.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks reviewers to look for injection, XSS, access control gaps, and secret exposure.
